Definition: adverb perhaps from the base of G5490 through the idea of a fissure in the soil; earthward, i.e. prostrate:--on (to) the ground.
BiblicalUsage: Chamai means on the ground, to the ground. Jesus spat on the ground and made clay to open blind eyes, and the soldiers who came to arrest Him went backward and fell to the ground at His word.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the ground is where Jesus does His work: clay for blind eyes, and strong men fallen flat at the sound of His name.
RelatedEvents: The Healing of the Man Born Blind; The Arrest of Jesus in Gethsemane
